summary: Bars a city or county from approving any discretionary or ministerial permit or entitlement for construction of a data center, or an expansion increasing maximum peak water use, unless the applicant provides a water supply assessment, a drought-stage water scarcity plan (from January 1, 2028), projected water use and efficiency measures, and workforce disclosures, and assumes the full cost of required water infrastructure. Satisfying the conditions does not require approval. Applies to charter cities.

source.citation: AB 2469, Chapter 436, Statutes of 2026 (chaptered text, LegiScan mirror)

notes: Workforce disclosures: composition, job classifications, duration, wage ranges and benefits, share residing in county and in state.
